description: This source file defines the ExecAllowlistMatcher enum, which provides static methods for matching executable paths against allowlist patterns using regular expressions.

classes.name: ExecAllowlistMatcher
classes.description: An enum containing static methods for matching executable entries against allowlist patterns.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches a given set of allowlist entries against a command resolution to find the first matching entry.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Returns all allowlist entries that match a list of command resolutions.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a given target path matches a pattern, considering tilde expansion and regex matching.

methods.name: normalizeMatchTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a path string by replacing backslashes with slashes and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: regex
methods.description: Converts a wildcard pattern into an NSRegularExpression for matching paths.
